Every quantity is either a theorem or an exhaustive enumeration whose answer is determined by data committed before this packet existed.
freeze_discipline.domain_is_closed_and_frozen: complete n<=3 StabPrep domain, 1146 instances, committed before this packet

independent_checker_requirements.independence_rule: Statistics must be recomputed from a regenerated feature matrix. The receipt may be compared but never used as an input. Module SHA-256 must be verified against the receipt before import; drift aborts with CANNOT_CHECK.
independent_checker_requirements.route_replay: extract_frozen_matrix.py - regenerate matrix, recompute all stage-1 statistics, diff against receipt
independent_checker_requirements.route_analysis: separator_complexity.py - Theorem B bound, exact structure-free null with permutation cross-check, k* by branch and bound
independent_checker_requirements.route_exhaustive: verify_minimality.py - exhaustive refutation of all subsets of size <= 3 by bitset covering, direct witness re-projection, block attribution. Shares no search logic with the branch and bound.
independent_checker_requirements.k_star_rule: k* may be reported as exact ONLY when both an exhaustive refutation of all smaller subsets and a directly verified witness are present. A branch-and-bound result alone must be reported as a bracket.
independent_checker_requirements.cannot_check_rule: Exit code 3 with status CANNOT_CHECK; never reported as a pass.

pipeline_validation_requirement.rule: Before any new number is believed, the extraction pipeline must reproduce at least three quantities recorded independently in the frozen receipt.
pipeline_validation_requirement.rationale: A separator-complexity number from an unvalidated extraction would be worthless. This is the checker-validation discipline applied to the checker itself.
